mapper.select: SELECT vendor_id, name FROM vendor_m WHERE status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name, p.price, p.stock_count AS stockCount, p.product_image AS productImage, v.name AS vendor,
-- ✅ live 할인 조건 (최신 라이브 할인만 적용) COALESCE(MAX(lp.discountRate), 0) AS discountRate,
CASE WHEN MAX(lp.discountRate) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(lp.discountRate) > 0 THEN FLOOR(p.price * (100 - MAX(lp.discountRate)) / 100) ELSE p.price END AS discountedPrice
FROM product p JOIN vendor_m v ON p.vendor_id = v.vendor_id LEFT JOIN live_product_j lp ON p.product_id = lp.product_id LEFT JOIN live_m l ON lp.live_id = l.live_id AND l.status_cd = 'ON' AND STR_TO_DATE(l.start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') <= NOW() AND (l.end_cd IS NULL OR l.end_cd = '') WHERE p.vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND p.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.price, p.stock_count, p.product_image, v.name
